  {"operation":"etymology","chain":"Paris (from Gaulish *pario- 'cauldron')","reading":"The cauldron; the vessel that boils and transforms","languages":["fr","la","cel"],"source":"Delamarre, Dictionnaire de la langue gauloise","confidence":0.75},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Pa + ris","reading":"The father of the ris (laughter, French rire); begetter of joy","languages":["fr","la"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.65},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Par + is","reading":"Through the is (ice, German Eis); that which passes through frozen matter","languages":["fr","de"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.55},
  {"operation":"cross_language_homophone","chain":"Paris ≈ Parvis (French)","reading":"The parvis; the sacred threshold before the temple","languages":["fr","la"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.7},
  {"operation":"cross_language_homophone","chain":"Paris ≈ Pâris (Greek Πάρις)","reading":"The one who judges beauty; the shepherd who awards the golden apple","languages":["fr","grc"],"source":"Homer, Iliad","confidence":0.6},
  {"operation":"anagram","chain":"Paris = Sapir","reading":"The sapphire; the stone that speaks (sapphire = 'speaking stone' in green language)","languages":["fr","he"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.5},

  {"operation":"letter_symbol","chain":"P (staff) + AR (eagle) + IS (ice)","reading":"The staff of the eagle frozen in ice; suspended royal power","languages":["en","fr"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.4},
  {"operation":"etymology","chain":"Parisium (medieval Latin) from *Parisiacum","reading":"The dwelling of the Parisi tribe; the cauldron-people","languages":["la","cel"],"source":"Caesar, De Bello Gallico + Delamarre","confidence":0.8},
  {"operation":"cross_language_homophone","chain":"Paris ≈ Baris (Egyptian barque of the dead)","reading":"The solar boat that carries souls across the sky","languages":["fr","egy"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.5},
  {"operation":"numerical","chain":"P=80 (greek), A=1, R=100, I=9, S=200 → 390","reading":"390 = the number of years the solar bird is reborn (phoenix cycle)","languages":["grc"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.35}
]
